entities.name: Sant'Antonio Taumaturgo, Trieste
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Church of Sant'Antonio Taumaturgo, is the main religious building in the Borgo Teresiano in the centre of Trieste as well as the city's largest Catholic church. It stands on a square also known as Sant’Antonio Nuovo, at the end of the Grand Canal.
